notes.title: Eight Balls ready for release
notes.content: Guys, long time no see. We are AbstractDreamGames and our game Eight Balls is finally ready for release. This game has many built-in modes, mainly related to platform jumping gameplay, and the gameplay is relatively rich. There's nothing to say, the game will be officially released on August 8th, 2024. Please, buddy, remember to come and support us then!!!
